s1.desc: an igloo kitchen with pale ice-brick walls and a curved teal counter

spans.view: with bowls of vegetables and a carrot on a cutting board on the counter beside her, and a jar on a wall shelf

beats.text: Polly stands at the counter whisking batter in a mixing bowl, little splatters of batter dotting her cheeks
Polly shuts her eyes for a moment with a happy smile
Polly beams and chatters, her beak opening and closing, swaying gently as she keeps whisking the batter
Polly closes her beak and looks ahead with wide eyes, still whisking
